beats.narration: The build logs. Sixteen layout defects found and fixed in VQA, twelve in BLIP. Two of BLIP's only existed in 9:16. And one was a clip of the wrong length, which no frame check can see. So read both cuts by hand.

beats.narration: The fixes. In 9:16, the verdict scene never drew its source note, and the outro let a long word overflow the safe edge. Both became toolkit patches. The wrong-length clip became a check of its own. Both fixes carry into every reel after this one.
